blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Supreme Court chief justice Artemio Panganiban on Wednesday asked whether it will be fair to allow senators who enjoy tourist spots abroad or those hiding “in the dark corners of the world” to participate in the impeachment trial’s voting process, when others have allotted time in hearing arguments and examining evidence. Panganiban, an opinion writer for the Inquirer, was one of four retired Supreme Court justices invited by the Senate Impeachment Court to serve as amici curiae tasked to provide views on issues concerning the voting threshold needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte. said senators must actively […]...
